name: What finishes are available for kitchen molding?

mainEntity.name: What finishes are available for kitchen molding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen molding is available in various finishes to match any kitchen design. Common options include paint-grade finishes, where the molding is primed and painted to match or contrast with your walls and cabinets. Stain-grade finishes highlight the natural wood grain, perfect for complementing wood cabinetry or flooring. Materials like MDF are typically paint-grade, while various hardwoods are ideal for staining. We can also provide custom finishes, such as distressed looks or specialty glazes, to achieve a unique aesthetic. The chosen finish significantly impacts the molding's durability and visual appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen molding finishes include paint-grade for color matching and stain-grade to highlight wood, with custom options also available.
